receipt.seed_note: Deterministic full SVD; no random seed is used
receipt.line_rule: Connect only adjacent observed periods when BOTH endpoints have at least minimum_line_songs; no interpolation across absent or sparse periods
receipt.interpretation: PCA distances retain only a fraction of embedding variance; axes are not fear, intensity, or historical prevalence scales. Temporal centroids describe changing selected-song composition, not motion of the same songs.
